title: Bregman Linearized Augmented Lagrangian Method for Nonconvex Constrained Stochastic Zeroth-order Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2504.09409v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In this paper, we study nonconvex constrained stochastic zeroth-order optimization problems, for which we have access to exact information of constraints and noisy function values of the objective. We propose a Bregman linearized augmented Lagrangian method that utilizes stochastic zeroth-order gradient estimators combined with a variance reduction technique. We analyze its oracle complexity, in terms of the total number of stochastic function value evaluations required to achieve an \(\epsilon\)-KKT point in \(\ell_p\)-norm metrics with \(p \ge 2\), where \(p\) is a parameter associated with the selected Bregman distance. In particular, starting from a near-feasible initial point and using Rademacher smoothing, the oracle complexity is in order \(O(p d^{2/p} \epsilon^{-3})\) for \(p \in [2, 2 \ln d]\), and \(O(\ln d \cdot \epsilon^{-3})\) for \(p > 2 \ln d\), where \(d\) denotes the problem dimension. translated_title: 布雷格曼线性化增广拉格朗日方法用于非凸约束随机零阶优化
translated_abstract: 在本文中，我们研究了非凸约束随机零阶优化问题，其中我们能够获得约束的精确信息和目标函数的含噪函数值。我们提出了一种布雷格曼线性化增广拉格朗日方法，该方法结合了随机零阶梯度估计器与方差缩减技术。我们分析了其预言复杂度，即在\(p \ge 2\)的\(\ell_p\)-范数度量下达到\(\epsilon\)-KKT点所需的总随机函数值评估次数，其中\(p\)是与所选布雷格曼距离相关的参数。特别地，从近似可行的初始点出发并使用Rademacher平滑，对于\(p \in [2, 2 \ln d]\)，预言复杂度为\(O(p d^{2/p} \epsilon^{-3})\)，对于\(p > 2 \ln d\)，为\(O(\ln d \cdot \epsilon^{-3})\)，其中\(d\)表示问题维度。这些结果表明，我们提出的方法在零阶优化中实现了高效性。
tldr: 提出了一种结合方差缩减的布雷格曼线性化增广拉格朗日方法，在非凸约束随机零阶优化中达到\(\epsilon\)-KKT点的预言复杂度为\(O(p d^{2/p} \epsilon^{-3})\)或\(O(\ln d \cdot \epsilon^{-3})\)。
en_tdlr: We propose a Bregman linearized augmented Lagrangian method with variance reduction for nonconvex constrained stochastic zeroth-order optimization, achieving oracle complexity of \(O(p d^{2/p} \epsilon^{-3})\) or \(O(\ln d \cdot \epsilon^{-3})\) to reach an \(\epsilon\)-KKT point.
